## Guides
- [What is SEO? An Introduction to SEO Basics](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/seo/): At its core, the meaning of search engine optimization \(SEO\) is increasing your website’s visibility in the organic search results of major search engines\.
- [Link Building for SEO: A Complete Guide](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/link-building-guide/): In this guide, you will learn how to reach out and use different link building techniques to improve the reach of your content and your site\.
- [Google Algorithm Updates \& Changes: A Complete History](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/google-algorithm-history/): Learn about the biggest and most important Google search algorithm launches, updates, and refreshes of all time – from 2003 to today\.
- [A Guide to Essential SEO Tools for Agencies](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/seo-tools/): This in\-depth guide will introduce you to the most valuable tools that your agency should be using for SEO – and why you should use them\.
- [Local SEO: The Definitive Guide to Improve Your Local Search Rankings](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/local-seo/): The basics of local search engine optimization\. Discover what local SEO is now, why it’s important, who benefits from it \(and who do not\)\.
- [A Complete PPC Marketing Guide for Beginners](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/ppc-guide/): A Beginner’s Guide to Pay Per Click Marketing will guide you through the fundamentals and essentials of PPC\. Learn how to do PPC right with this ebook\!
- [Content Marketing KPIs: Your Guide to Picking the Right KPIs for Content](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/content-marketing-kpis/): This comprehensive guide covers why KPIs are essential in content marketing, the importance of aligning your content marketing goals and metrics, and how to pick the right KPIs that truly matter to your business\.
- [Ecommerce Marketing: The Definitive Guide](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/ecommerce-guide/): This comprehensive guide will teach retailers and marketers on how to create a search\-friendly ecommerce website that attracts traffic and sales\.
- [Advanced Technical SEO: A Complete Guide](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/technical-seo/): Learn the most important technical SEO strategies that every practitioner needs to know in our guide to Advanced Technical SEO\.
- [The Complete Guide to On\-Page SEO](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/on-page-seo/): Learn about the top on\-page SEO factors that impact your pages’ visibility on the SERPs in our guide to on\-page SEO\.
- [What Is Social Media?](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/social-media/): Social media refers to digital platforms that allow user interaction and sharing user\-generated content through an online app for networking purposes
- [A Complete Guide to Holiday Marketing](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/holiday-marketing/): In this guide, we’ll show you how to leverage SEO, PPC, email, social media and content to deliver an engaging and personalized omnichannel experience to your customers\.
- [How Search Engines Work](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/search-engines/): Do you know how search engines work? Find out how Google discovers, indexes, and ranks web pages in this book for SEO pros and search users\.
- [How to Do an SEO Audit: The Ultimate Checklist](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/seo-audit/): The Ultimate SEO Audit Checklist is a comprehensive list of all the important items that should be included in your in\-depth SEO audit\.
- [Content Marketing: The Ultimate Beginner's Guide](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/content-marketing/): Content marketing can help you attract leads, win more sales, and grow your business\. Here's everything you need to know to get started and do it right\.
- [Enterprise SEO Guide: Strategies, Tools, \& More](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/enterprise-seo/): Enterprise SEO strategies, top tools, and valuable information to help you better optimize your enterprise site for search\.
- [Law Firm SEO: The Complete Guide](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/law-firm-seo/): This guide explores the fundamentals you need to know in order to boost your law firm’s online presence and generate a steady flow of new leads for your business\.
- [How to Advertise on Facebook: A Beginner's Guide](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/facebook-ads/): Advertising on Facebook is a powerful way to reach people interested in your product or service\. Done right, running Facebook Ads can drive leads, conversions, and ROI\.
- [WordPress SEO Guide: Everything You Need to Know](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/wordpress-seo/): Need guidance on how to get WordPress SEO right? Here are the best practices for optimizing your WordPress website for search and users today\.
- [Core Web Vitals: A Complete Guide](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/core-web-vitals/): In\-depth exploration and explanation of LCP, INP, and CLS\. Google’s insights into how Core Web Vitals work\.
- [Keyword Research: An In\-Depth Beginner’s Guide](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/keyword-research/): Keyword research is the foundation of search engine optimization\. This guide covers what it is and how you should do keyword research\.
- [Your Guide to Google E\-A\-T \& SEO](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/google-eat/): Your Guide to Google E\-A\-T \& SEO will help answer questions like: What is E\-A\-T, and why does it matter? Is E\-A\-T a ranking factor?
- [Google Ranking Systems \& Signals](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/ranking-factors/): So if you’ve ever wondered what is and isn’t a ranking factor – or had to make the case to do or not to do something “because it’s a Google ranking factor” – this guide is for you\.
- [B2B Lead Generation: Create Content That Converts](https://www.searchenginejournal.com/b2b-lead-generation/): Our latest ebook, B2B Lead Generation: Create Content That Converts, is packed with powerful insights to help you elevate your content marketing strategy\.

}
.sej-header-v2 .sej-header--container {
    height: 4.6875rem;
    z-index: auto;
}
.sej-header-v2 .sej-menu-items-v2 {
    gap: clamp(.75rem, 1.2vw, 1.5rem);
    margin-inline-end: 0;
    min-width: 0;
}

    .sej-header-v2 .sej-other-links {
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        height: 2.75rem;
        justify-content: center;
    }
    .sej-header-v2 #ssub {
        align-items: center;
        display: flex;
        height: 2.75rem;
        justify-content: center;
        width: 2.75rem;

        height: 2.75rem;
        position: relative;
        right: auto;

    }

        display: none;
    }
    .slide-search .sej-srch-box {
        display: flex;
    }
    .sej-header-v2 .sej-srch-ic-hide {
        align-items: center;
        bottom: auto;
        height: 2.75rem;
        justify-content: center;
        left: 0;
        padding: 0;
        right: auto;
        top: 50%;
        transform: translateY(-50%);
        width: 2.75rem;
    }
}
.sej-mega-v2,
.sej-mega-v2__list,
.sej-mega-v2__item,
.sej-mega-v2__top-row {
    height: 100%;
}
.sej-mega-v2 {
    --sej-mega-accent: #54c41a;
    flex: 0 1 auto;
    margin-inline-end: auto;
    margin-inline-start: clamp(1.75rem, 2.5vw, 3rem);
    min-width: 0;
}
.sej-mega-v2 :where(ul, li) {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
}
.sej-mega-v2__list {
    align-items: stretch;
    display: flex;
    gap: clamp(.5rem, .55vw, .65rem);
    justify-content: flex-start;
}
.sej-mega-v2__item,
.sej-mega-v2__top-row {
    align-items: center;
    display: flex;
}
.sej-mega-v2__item {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
}
.sej-mega-v2__top-row {
    position: relative;
}
.sej-mega-v2__top-link {
    align-items: center;
    color: #111 !important;
    display: flex;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    height: 2.25rem;
    line-height: 1.2;
    padding-inline: .75rem;
    position: relative;
    text-decoration: none;
    white-space: nowrap;
}
.sej-mega-v2 .sej-mega-v2__top-link {
    text-decoration: none;
}
.sej-mega-v2__item--webinars .sej-mega-v2__top-link {
    background: #e6f5e4;
    border-radius: 999px;
    height: 2.25rem;
    padding-inline: 1.2rem;
}
.sej-mega-v2__submenu-toggle,
.sej-mega-v2__mobile-head,
.sej-mega-v2__mobile-tools,
.sej-mega-v2__mobile-cta,
.sej-mega-v2__open,
.sej-mega-v2__overlay,
.sej-mega-v2__panel {
    display: none;
}
@media (max-width: 89.9375rem) and (min-width: 75rem) {
    .sej-header-v2 .sej-logo {
        flex-basis: 10.625rem;
        max-width: 10.625rem;
    }
    .sej-mega-v2 {
        margin-inline-start: clamp(1rem, 1.25vw, 1.75rem);
    }
    .sej-mega-v2__list {
        gap: clamp(.25rem, .5vw, .65rem);
    }
    .sej-mega-v2__top-link {
        font-size: .875rem;
        padding-inline: .5rem;

    .sej-header-v2 .link-sect {
        margin-right: 1.125rem;
    }

    .sej-header--outer-v2 {

    }
    .sej-header-v2 .sej-header--container {
        height: 3.75rem;
    }
    .sej-header-v2 .sej-logo {
        inset-inline-start: 4.75rem;
        margin: 0;
        max-width: 13rem;
        position: absolute;
    }
    .sej-header-v2 .sej-menu-items-v2 {
        justify-content: flex-end;
        margin-inline-start: auto;
        margin-inline-end: 0;
    }
    .sej-mega-v2__open {
        align-items: center;
        background: transparent;
        border: 0;
        color: #111;
        cursor: pointer;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: .25rem;
        height: 2.75rem;
        justify-content: center;
        min-width: 2.75rem;
        padding: .6rem;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 7;
    }

        background: currentColor;
        border-radius: 999px;
        display: block;
        height: .15rem;
        width: 1.35rem;
    }
    .sej-mega-v2 {
        --sej-admin-offset: 0px;
        background: #fff;
        bottom: 0;
        box-shadow: .35rem 0 1.25rem rgb(0 0 0 / 25%);
        display: block;
        left: 0;
        max-width: 24rem;
        margin: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
        position: fixed;
        top: var(--sej-admin-offset);
        transform: translateX(-110%);
        transition: transform .2s ease;
        width: min(87vw, 24rem);
        z-index: 9;
    }
    .admin-bar .sej-mega-v2 {
        --sej-admin-offset: 2rem;
    }
}
@media (max-width: 35.999rem) {
    .sej-header-v2 .sej-logo {
        inset-inline-start: 4.1rem;
        max-width: min(11.25rem, calc(100vw - 11rem));
    }
}
@media (max-width: 782px) {
    .admin-bar .sej-mega-v2 {
        --sej-admin-offset: 2.875rem;
    }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .sej-mega-v2 {
        transition: none;
    }
}

}

        display: flex;
    }

        align-items: center;

        right: auto;
        top: 50%;
        transform: translateY(-50%);
        width: 2.75rem;
    }

.sej-mega-v2__list,
.sej-mega-v2__item,
.sej-mega-v2__top-row {
    height: 100%;
}

    margin-inline-end: auto;
    margin-inline-start: clamp(1.75rem, 2.5vw, 3rem);
    min-width: 0;
}
.sej-mega-v2 :where(ul, li) {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
}

    align-items: stretch;
    display: flex;
    gap: clamp(.5rem, .55vw, .65rem);
    justify-content: flex-start;
}
.sej-mega-v2__item,
.sej-mega-v2__top-row {
    align-items: center;
    display: flex;
}
.sej-mega-v2__item {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
}
.sej-mega-v2__top-row {
    position: relative;
}

    color: #111 !important;
    display: flex;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    height: 2.25rem;
    line-height: 1.2;
    padding-inline: .75rem;
    position: relative;

        --sej-admin-offset: 2.875rem;
    }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .sej-mega-v2 {
        transition: none;
    }
}

}
.sej-header-v2 .sej-header--container {
    height: 4.6875rem;
    z-index: auto;
}
.sej-header-v2 .sej-menu-items-v2 {
    gap: clamp(.75rem, 1.2vw, 1.5rem);
    margin-inline-end: 0;
    min-width: 0;
}

    .sej-header-v2 .sej-other-links {
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        height: 2.75rem;
        justify-content: center;
    }
    .sej-header-v2 #ssub {
        align-items: center;
        display: flex;
        height: 2.75rem;
        justify-content: center;
        width: 2.75rem;

        height: 2.75rem;
        position: relative;
        right: auto;
        width: 2.75rem;
    }

        display: none;
    }
    .slide-search .sej-srch-box {
        display: flex;
    }
    .sej-header-v2 .sej-srch-ic-hide {
        align-items: center;
        bottom: auto;
        height: 2.75rem;
        justify-content: center;
        left: 0;
        padding: 0;
        right: auto;
        top: 50%;
        transform: translateY(-50%);
        width: 2.75rem;
    }
}
.sej-mega-v2,
.sej-mega-v2__list,
.sej-mega-v2__item,
.sej-mega-v2__top-row {
    height: 100%;
}
.sej-mega-v2 {
    --sej-mega-accent: #54c41a;
    flex: 0 1 auto;
    margin-inline-end: auto;
    margin-inline-start: clamp(1.75rem, 2.5vw, 3rem);
    min-width: 0;
}
.sej-mega-v2 :where(ul, li) {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
}
.sej-mega-v2__list {
    align-items: stretch;
    display: flex;
    gap: clamp(.5rem, .55vw, .65rem);
    justify-content: flex-start;
}
.sej-mega-v2__item,
.sej-mega-v2__top-row {
    align-items: center;
    display: flex;
}
.sej-mega-v2__item {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
}
.sej-mega-v2__top-row {
    position: relative;
}
.sej-mega-v2__top-link {
    align-items: center;
    color: #111 !important;
    display: flex;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    height: 2.25rem;
    line-height: 1.2;
    padding-inline: .75rem;
    position: relative;
    text-decoration: none;
    white-space: nowrap;
}
.sej-mega-v2 .sej-mega-v2__top-link {
    text-decoration: none;
}
.sej-mega-v2__item--webinars .sej-mega-v2__top-link {
    background: #e6f5e4;
    border-radius: 999px;
    height: 2.25rem;
    padding-inline: 1.2rem;
}
.sej-mega-v2__submenu-toggle,
.sej-mega-v2__mobile-head,
.sej-mega-v2__mobile-tools,
.sej-mega-v2__mobile-cta,
.sej-mega-v2__open,
.sej-mega-v2__overlay,
.sej-mega-v2__panel {
    display: none;
}
@media (max-width: 89.9375rem) and (min-width: 75rem) {
    .sej-header-v2 .sej-logo {
        flex-basis: 10.625rem;
        max-width: 10.625rem;
    }
    .sej-mega-v2 {
        margin-inline-start: clamp(1rem, 1.25vw, 1.75rem);
    }
    .sej-mega-v2__list {
        gap: clamp(.25rem, .5vw, .65rem);
    }
    .sej-mega-v2__top-link {
        font-size: .875rem;
        padding-inline: .5rem;

        margin-right: 1.125rem;
    }

    .sej-header--outer-v2 {
        padding-bottom: 3.75rem;
    }
    .sej-header-v2 .sej-header--container {
        height: 3.75rem;
    }
    .sej-header-v2 .sej-logo {
        inset-inline-start: 4.75rem;
        margin: 0;
        max-width: 13rem;
        position: absolute;
    }
    .sej-header-v2 .sej-menu-items-v2 {
        justify-content: flex-end;
        margin-inline-start: auto;
        margin-inline-end: 0;
    }
    .sej-mega-v2__open {
        align-items: center;
        background: transparent;
        border: 0;
        color: #111;
        cursor: pointer;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: .25rem;
        height: 2.75rem;
        justify-content: center;
        min-width: 2.75rem;
        padding: .6rem;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 7;
    }
    .sej-mega-v2__open span {
        background: currentColor;
        border-radius: 999px;
        display: block;
        height: .15rem;
        width: 1.35rem;
    }
    .sej-mega-v2 {
        --sej-admin-offset: 0px;
        background: #fff;
        bottom: 0;
        box-shadow: .35rem 0 1.25rem rgb(0 0 0 / 25%);
        display: block;
        left: 0;
        max-width: 24rem;
        margin: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
        position: fixed;
        top: var(--sej-admin-offset);
        transform: translateX(-110%);
        transition: transform .2s ease;
        width: min(87vw, 24rem);
        z-index: 9;
    }
    .admin-bar .sej-mega-v2 {
        --sej-admin-offset: 2rem;
    }
}
@media (max-width: 35.999rem) {
    .sej-header-v2 .sej-logo {
        inset-inline-start: 4.1rem;
        max-width: min(11.25rem, calc(100vw - 11rem));
    }
}
@media (max-width: 782px) {
    .admin-bar .sej-mega-v2 {
        --sej-admin-offset: 2.875rem;
    }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .sej-mega-v2 {
        transition: none;
    }
}
